body_html:

  • Keep glass and tile spot-free after every shower with a smooth, easy-glide blade.
  • Store it right where you need it using the included wall-mounted hook for a tidy shower area.
  • Built for lasting strength with solid brass construction.
  • Maintain long-term performance with a blade that can be easily replaced.
